interpretation: The existing confirmed-basis calculator works as designed but does not reconcile chargeable income to saved facts. Passing arithmetic/browser tests cannot prove a complete gross-income-to-return workflow.
required_resolution: Define and preserve the legally applicable adjustments from saved income through statutory/aggregate/total/chargeable income
Reconcile the calculation basis to that schedule before presenting an assessed workflow as complete
Retain explicit handling for foreign, separate-rate, joint-assessment and loss cases rather than imposing an unsupported universal gross-income ceiling
Test both consistent schedules and unexplained mismatches through save/run/reopen APIs

statutory_source_review.status: Main-Act provisions 42-45 read directly; detailed source-level deductions and all current-year relief eligibility still require implementation review
statutory_source_review.ruling_fetch: PR 5/2022 official URL returned 404 in browser and 500 in direct fetch; not archived or admitted
statutory_source_review.locator_method: Verified main-Act headings and numbered provisions, including starred headings; excluded schedules with reused numbers

required_calculation_stages.requirement: Adjusted source income plus applicable Schedule 3 charges less applicable allowances; positive additions can exist.
Prior eligible business losses reduce business statutory income, limited to that business-income aggregate; other statutory income and Schedule 4 additions are separate.
Apply current-year adjusted losses and subsequent statutory deduction groups in prescribed order, preserving any excess-loss treatment.
Total income less Chapter 7 deductions; joint assessment is a separate election path.

implementation_decision: Do not enforce a universal gross-income ceiling or subtract the single carried_losses field from all income. Implement a staged reconciliation schedule with source-specific business loss limits and explicit additions, preserving unsupported cases until their rules are established.

Workpaper is retained in the immutable run basis and stage results in the saved result
Existing form captures adjustments and displays reconciliation stages
remaining: Eligibility and statutory deduction ordering remain verified inputs
Nonresident and foreign/special regimes need complete workpapers
Expand business-case acceptance and result-stage browser assertions

verified: Rejected mismatched basis preserves case revision and result
Valid workpaper and source indices survive database reopening
Duplicate source indices cannot overwrite accepted result
api_atomicity_checkpoint.deduction_summary: Saved claimed_deductions must equal source deductions plus statutory allowances plus total-income deductions plus personal reliefs; prior losses are separate. UI explains this convention.
api_atomicity_checkpoint.limits: Deduction eligibility and ordered statutory limits remain verified inputs; no automatic full-return or carryforward eligibility claim.
